description: N49 visual metrics -> DAWproject volume automation. Same settings as N48: frame step 30 (1.0 s/row), zoom-direction metrics, rank normalisation. Transport 108 bpm 4/4.

video_processing._comment_process_every_nth_frame: Integer video-frame step between analysis rows. 30/30 = exactly one analysis row per second. Fixes the time resolution permanently: everything else re-derives from basic.csv in seconds, but a finer rate means re-decoding the video. Smoothing widths quantise to odd multiples of this spacing, so at 1 s/row the shortest usable filter is 3 s.

metrics_processing._comment_color_channels: Outer product with 'metrics'. Available: R G B Gray S V H000 H060 H120 H180 H240 H300 Hmon. Empty list = all.
metrics_processing._comment_metrics: Available per channel -- combinations that do not exist are skipped. R/G/B/S/V: avg std gmn gs1. H000..H300: int std. Hmon: std. Gray-only camera motion: czd = signed zoom divergence (positive is zoom IN; magnifying moves features outward so the flow diverges), and its half-wave split czi = zoom-in speed, czo = zoom-out speed, cza = zoom speed either way -- each of czi/czo is zero unless the camera is moving that way, so separate sounds can follow each direction. Same split for rotation: crc signed, crl counterclockwise, crr clockwise, cra either way. Gray also has cmv dcd dcl ed0-2 ee0-2 es0-2 ga1-6 gm1-6 gmb gs2-6 rad rsn rss. Empty list = all.
metrics_processing._comment_rank_types: v = raw value, r = percentile rank. Empty = both.
metrics_processing._comment_inversions: o = original, i = 1 - value. Empty = both.
metrics_processing._comment_filter_seconds: Triangular smoothing width in seconds, converted to the nearest odd number of analysis rows. 4.4444 s is two bars of 4/4 at 108 bpm (4 beats = 2.2222 s). N48 used 4.75 s because that was one third of its 16.2 s zoom cycle; with no known cycle here, the bar length is the sensible analogue. Cheap to change: re-run with process_video and process_metrics false.
metrics_processing._comment_block_seconds: Block-average widths in seconds, piecewise constant. Suffix _b016s etc.
metrics_processing._comment_stretch: Logistic stretch: outer product of stretch_values x stretch_centers. If both are empty the identity stretch _s1-0.5 is emitted instead.

dawproject._comment: Every column of the values CSV becomes one track. There is no column list: narrow metrics_processing to get fewer.
dawproject._comment_transport: Cubase overwrites the target project's initial tempo marking and time signature with these on import, so set them to match that project. Both are always written: Cubase will not load a file with no Tempo, and with no TimeSignature it imposes 4/4 rather than leaving the signature untouched.
